overview_description.description: Hut 8 Corp. is a cryptocurrency mining and Blockchain infrastructure company established through an exclusive partnership with Bitfury, one of the world’s leading Blockchain technology companies. Hut 8 Corp. currently owns bitcoin mining data centers representing 24.2 MW and 165 PH/s that are in operation or under construction, with a pipeline of acquisition and development opportunities across North America. Hut 8 Corp. is led by a team of industry experts to provide investors with exposure to Blockchain processing infrastructure and technology along with underlying cryptocurrency rewards and revenue from transaction fees.
